header.sector: Optical interconnects, transceivers and datacenter networking
header.title: AI datacenter optical shift drives VCSEL NPO suppliers' unit demand to 2031

s01_bottom_line.text: TrendForce projects VCSEL sales to reach 650 million units by 2031 at a 38% CAGR from 2025, driven by AI datacenter demand for short-reach optical interconnects, with six leading suppliers investing in VCSEL NPO solutions expected to launch 2027-2028. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
The article positions VCSEL NPO as a highly competitive option for scale-up optical interconnect architectures, with suppliers investing to capture future scale-up network opportunities.

The forecast implies rising volume opportunity for the named optical component suppliers, but the article does not quantify revenue, pricing or margin impact per supplier, nor each supplier's share of the 650M-unit market.
